instructions: 1. Subjects sheet: common subjects you don't have yet are already listed. Delete the rows you don't teach and add your own below. Leave Short name blank to get a suggested one.
2. Teachers sheet: one teacher per row, name without the title. Grades are required, and Subjects too unless Primary teacher is Yes.
Names: every subject and teacher needs a name in English or Sinhala. Fill both if you can. When one is empty, the app shows the other.
3. Staff ID: leave blank to number teachers automatically.
4. Subjects: separate with commas, or with semicolons (;) if a subject name has a comma. Use the English, Sinhala or short name of a subject in this file or already in Sathiya.
5. Grades: e.g. 6-9, 11. Max periods/day: blank means 7. Primary teacher: Yes or No.

6. Staff ID, Phone and Grades are formatted as Plain text so Excel doesn't turn 6-9 into a date or drop a phone's leading 0. Keep that formatting; if you paste data, use Paste Values or format those columns as Plain text.
7. Don't change the column headings. Up to 200 rows per sheet.
8. Save as .xlsx. If you save a CSV instead, choose "CSV UTF-8" so Sinhala text is kept.
